description: One request queued for the event master thread.

Every change to the event master - a client registering, changing its subscription, leaving, or an event being added - is posted as one of these rather than applied directly, so the callers never block on the event master's lock.

attributes.name: operation
description: Which request this is: `EVR_ADD_EVC`, `EVR_MOD_EVC`, `EVR_DEL_EVC` or `EVR_ADD_EVENT`. See `sge_event.h`.

attributes.name: timestamp
description: When the request was posted, so the event master can order and age requests.

attributes.name: event_client_id
description: Which event client the request is about.

attributes.name: event_number
description: The client's event serial the request refers to.

attributes.name: session
description: The session the request belongs to, so a client sees its own changes.

attributes.name: event_client
description: The event client object (`EV`), for the register and modify operations.
